text: The meeting established that Ed will provide a written project plan by the next meeting, including functional and technical design, team size, timeframe, budget, and marketing plan.
The UI protocol was set to CC Ed on all discussions and copy PM on all mails and discussions, while PM will distribute slides to attendees after the meeting.

Several problems were highlighted: confusion about the project goal and deliverables (monitor vs remote control), lack of any functional/technical design, and absence of a formal written plan hindering funding.
Decisions anchored on a formal plan: the project plan will be delivered by the next meeting, with a written plan including designs within two weeks, specifying required team, timeframe, and budget.
